head_commit.message:
runtime: add portable KB launcher and capture leases

Use one standalone engine for checkout and packaged cluster commands. Private
versioned identities, prepared artifacts and fresh run receipts bind owned
resources to immutable source. Cold resume retains the accepted artifact;
updates prepare exact guest closures before stopping and preserve disks,
credentials and resolved SSH endpoints. Lifecycle contention refuses before
mutation. Unsupported legacy state remains untouched.

Capture and validation share explicit connection and artifact-root contracts.
Hold the artifact flock in the writing process through publication and cleanup;
cancel capture after lease loss. Prove administrator API and member browser
identities for the small inventory fixture. Keep committed media validation
as a separate strict hosted gate.

Bind readiness to the exact live run and discover all SSH keys within one
deadline without changing retained trust. Preserve child authority across
interruption. Give the runner its own session and retain its control listener,
tracker and reapers through one graceful shutdown. Notify accepted shutdown
even if its reply fails. Observe every process task and prove exit before
explicit machine cleanup and completion. Authenticated live shutdown may
retire only its pinned unchanged socket after complete exit; interruption
cannot reconstruct authority for a dead residual.

Forward non-terminal input through public SSH so piped scripts reach the
remote command. Terminal invocations remain noninteractive.

Pass machine-owned listening sockets to virtiofsd through its descriptor API
so ordinary shutdown leaves no daemon pidfiles. Pin socket and directory
identities through exact-path cleanup, keep OSVM daemon/reaper ownership,
and refuse old residues and replaced paths without adopting cleanup authority.

Qualify the installed public commands with one final-source cluster and
ordinary stop/resume. Use two 2 GiB guests, an 8 GiB services image and root,
and an 8 GiB tank; align image-builder RAM with the services setting. Separate
the 24 GiB output envelope from closures, staging and retained-host reserves,
and use assessed sequential memory peaks. These are finite fit targets rather
than proven minima. A new verifier campaign kind refuses superseded roots and
arguments without changing engine state formats. Historical upgrades and
two-instance proof remain deferred; native failure ends the qualification.

Preserve resource-producer failures before formatting observations. Select
available inodes through the GNU df output field without conflicting flags,
and exercise the actual generated shell in the consuming verifier tests.

Observe the current process receipt as an authenticated append-only
publication during lease checks. Preserve every other retained file and
claim while allowing safe atomic replacement and its narrowly named
unpublished files. These observations grant no lifecycle authority.

Hold both runtime-fixture TCP probes through selection so ephemeral port
reuse cannot create duplicate SSH and HTTPS resource requests.

Persist each node's single Ed25519 host key on its retained tank after pool
and mount checks. Services and optional DNS retain the same single-key policy
on their writable roots. Volatile node roots must not regenerate identity
on resume, and one configured algorithm avoids partial multi-key discovery
without enlarging retained trust. Older artifacts receive no key migration.
